title: i☆Ris Voice Actress Idol Unit to Disband at End of 2027
content: The official website for the i☆Ris voice actress idol unit announced on Sunday that the group will end its activities at the end of 2027, which also marks the group's 15th anniversary.
author: ANN

title: Yasuki Tanaka's Ghost Fixers Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content: Tanaka launched the manga on Shonen Jump+ in March 2024. Shueisha published the manga's seventh compiled volume on March 4. MANGA Plus is publishing the manga in English, and it describes the story: Following a certain event, Mikurigaoka New Town transformed into a crucible of supernatural phenomena known as GHOSTS!
author: ANN

title: Boichi's The Marshal King Manga Ends on October 16
content: Boichi 's The Marshal King manga revealed in its 33rd chapter on Friday that it will end in the next chapter on October 16. The manga went on hiatus in December and resumed on September 4.
author: ANN

title: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady's Treasure Film Streams Video Highlighting Jinshi, Maomao
content: TOHO animation began streaming a character trailer on Saturday for The Apothecary Diaries : The Late Lady's Treasure ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto: Bо̄hi no Hihо̄ ), the upcoming film for the anime based on Hyuganatsu and Touko Shino 's The Apothecary Diaries ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) light novel series.

title: 'Shishite Ikiru SSS-kyuu Hunter' Reveals Additional Cast, Ending Theme, Second Promo
content: The official website of the television anime adaptation of Sinnoa and Bill K 's SSS-Class Revival Hunter webtoon revealed additional cast members, ending theme artists, and a second promotional video on Sunday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in January 2027 on Fuji TV's +Ultra programming block.
author: MyAnimeList

title: SSS-Class Revival Hunter Anime Reveals 8 More Cast, 2nd Promo Video, Ending Theme Artists
content: The official website for the television anime of writer Sinnoa 's SSS-Class Revival Hunter web novel and adaptor Neida and artist Bill K 's webtoon revealed more cast, the anime's second promotional video, and the ending theme song artists on Sunday. The anime had screened at New York Comic Con on Saturday evening.
author: ANN

title: 5 Live-Action Anime That Put Dragon Ball: Evolution to Shame
content: Live-action adaptations of anime and manga have always been controversial, and there’s a major reason why. These adaptations, whether they’re fantasies or even slice-of-life about daily lives, tend to change everything from the original manga, which doesn’t sit well with many fans.
author: ComicBook

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Miss Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End
content: There’s no denying that Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End is the biggest fantasy anime of the decade. The anime premiered in 2023, and since then, its popularity only keeps rising. The anime is all set to return with Season 3 next year to adapt the best arc in the manga so far.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Also Streams on Hulu in U.S. on October 11
content: The series will begin airing on the Fuji TV channel and its affiliates on October 11 at 11:15 p.m. JST (10:15 a.m. EDT), taking over the timeslot of the One Piece anime, which aired its last episode for this year on September 27.
author: ANN
